coaching.headline: Yurei's first blood and eight kills set the tempo; the team closed it 20-10 and 45,324 to 1,330 on objectives.
coaching.team: Yurei set the pace with first blood at 4.1, then 8/1 and team-high 25,320 objective damage. We won five fights and converted three; the 11.6 River was ours, so 23.3 was the missed conversion: we won 3-0, but the river camp went to them. Next time, turn that won fight into the camp or a structure. We closed 20-10 with 45,324 objective damage to their 1,330.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Yurei's first blood on Zinx at 4.1 opened the game, and the duo lane never lost pace: Sparrow finished 3 kills to 6 deaths. Fangtooth fell to us at 8 in the same window, and from there the fight count never came back for the other side.
coaching.whatWorked: Yurei's aggression: eight kills, one death, and 25,320 objective damage, more than half the team's total damage to objectives.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Demiurge fits GRIM.exe's item-driven output in both his marksman and mage forms, scaling extra power and item effects from the build he ran tonight.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Lt. Belica built two of the three winning-core items, Combustion and Wraith Leggings, swapping Noxia's magic penetration for Orb Of Enlightenment's early scaling — and the output backed it, the team's highest damage to heroes at 17,269.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Demiurge fits Lt. Belica's item-driven burst rotation against squishies, scaling extra power and item effects from the build, matching the highest damage output on the team tonight.

ef36f715-3cf2-45f0-a1b0-0293c61058c4.build: Yurei built two of the three winning-core items, Malady and Spear Of Desolation, swapping The Perforator for Tainted Trident — and carried no magic resist into a comp that ran three magical damage sources, the flag the engine raised directly.
ef36f715-3cf2-45f0-a1b0-0293c61058c4.eternal: Demiurge fits Yurei's item-driven chain-kill kit, scaling extra power from the build that produced eight kills and 25,320 objective damage tonight.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Steel built two of the three winning-core items, Xenia and Dynamo, swapping Gaia Greaves' armor for Cursed Scroll's damage — a clean match to the winning core.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: The engine doesn't model support Eternals like Exarch, Weald or Marrow, so there's no fit read for Steel here beyond noting the field mostly runs a peel-first major on frontline supports like this.

focus.title: A won river fight still needs the river camp.
focus.evidence: At 23.3 we won 3–0 at river, but the camp went to them. At 11.6 we took River, so the late miss was a conversion problem, not a match-long river-control failure.
focus.action: After winning a river fight, secure the camp or use the numbers edge on a nearby structure before resetting.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Energy Shield block → Displacement Blast → Assault Mode → GTFO lockon ult
ourKits.winCondition: out-trade with Pulsefire and the spell-shield, finish with GTFO
ourKits.playWith: peel so he can free-cast in Assault Mode
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Energy Shield, then commit; dodge GTFO's slow channel

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Anima Burst / Whispering Echoes apply Soul Rip → Severance resets on Soul-Ripped targets → Soulstorm pulls them in
ourKits.winCondition: chain Severance resets to stick to a target and burst in melee
ourKits.passive: casting grants ranged empowered basics + attack speed
ourKits.playWith: follow-up CC to hold the target she dashes onto
ourKits.playAgainst: her chain needs Soul Rip resets — peel/disengage breaks it; punish when Severance is on cooldown

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Mark a target → Hive slow → Swarm reposition → Curse execute-burst ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Mark + Curse a squishy and delete them with %max-HP Pestilence
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds her marked target
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's squishy with one escape (Swarm) — dive after it's used; spread vs Hive

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

members.text: Gain 20% Movement Speed and 10% Physical Power for 7s. Takedowns within 7s permanently grant 3 Physical Power and refreshes the duration.

stacks.text: 2 effects on one trigger: Malady, Ortus. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.

countered.text: 1 of the 4 players Yurei killed built physical armor (Zinx).

copy.text: Too few Yurei jungle games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.
